L3: The positive effect of Elenagen 【0†was demonstrated in pilot studies on dogs and cats with spontaneous tumors of different localizations.†www.oncotarget.com】 In some cases, the use of Elenagen led to a full recovery of the animals.
L4: Our pilot study on dogs and cats diagnosed with cancer followed 【1†preclinical studies in laboratory animals challenged with sarcoma, breast cancer, melanoma and lung carcinoma.†www.oncotarget.com】 In addition, a full scope of 【1†safety and preclinical toxicity studies was completed.†www.oncotarget.com】
L5: 
L6: In companion animals, Elenagen has demonstrated the highest promise for unresectable tumors with no option of surgical intervention.
L7: Treatment with Elenagen resulted in reduction of tumor size, tumor disintegration from surrounding tissues, and/or tumor encapsulation—which in some cases made tumors resectable. Furthermore, according to the preliminary results, the administration of Elenagen after tumor resections prevents tumor recurrence and metastasis development.
